name: trainhorn-mcp
description: Train horn calculators for assistants: loudness vs distance, air tank runtime, compressor recovery and wire gauge.
long_description: Five tools that compute, instead of guess, the numbers people ask about when they plan an air horn or train horn setup on a car or truck: the sound level at a distance from a rated dB figure (inverse-square law, optional ISO 9613 air absorption), the distance at which a horn drops to a given level, seconds of horn time from an air tank (Boyle's law) and blast count, compressor recovery time (constant or linear flow model), and the smallest copper AWG for a 12/24 V run by voltage drop. Every result comes with its assumptions. Includes a short 'horn law basics' note (not legal advice). Runs locally, no network access, no data stored. Maths ported from the tested trainhorn-calc core by Train Horn (train-horn.com).
